violations.text: The menus for the restaurant do not have an allergen statement posted for consumer awareness. A general allergen statement must be present on all menus. New Violation. Correct By: 07/02/2026

Molluscan Shellfish tags did not have all of the required information. The last date of sale was lacking. Molluscan shellfish tags must be maintained for 90 days in chronological order and the date when the last shellfish was used from the bag must be noted on the shellfish tag. New Violation. Correct By: 07/02/2026

Raw animal foods (such as cripsy chicken) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (such as lobster) in the flip top prep unit. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Foods were relocated to proper areas. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/02/2026

The quaternary ammonium concentration in the sanitizing solution of the 3-bay sink was 100 parts per million (ppm). According to the manufacturer's use directions, the concentration of the quaternary ammonium must be 150-400 ppm. New Violation. Correct By: 07/02/2026

Various foods in the flip top prep unit were observed held at 50-55 degrees Fahrenheit. The ambient air temperature of the unit was observed at 50 degrees Fahrenheit. The temperature setting on the unit was observed to be turned down. Temperature setting adjusted at time of inspection. All TCS foods observed in the unit was voluntarily disposed of by person in charge. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/02/2026

Reduced oxygen packaged tuna, swordfish, and salmon were observed thawing with the package in-tact. Any food observed over 38 degrees were voluntarily disposed of by person in charge. Food under 38 degrees were removed from the packaging to properly thaw. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/02/2026

The painted ceiling in the kitchen area was observed to have peeling/chipped paint. Painted surface is to be properly repaired and resealed. (Proper coatings for indoor surfaces were discussed at the time of inspection.) New Violation. Correct By: 05/31/2026

The ceiling in the basement warewashing and food prep areas was observed to have tiles that are not smooth and easily cleanable. The ceiling is to be constructed of SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE surfaces for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted and Nonabsorbent for areas subject to moisture such as FOOD preparation areas, walk-in refrigerators, WAREWASHING areas, toilet rooms, mobile FOOD ESTABLISHMENT SERVICING AREAS, and areas subject to flushing or spray cleaning methods. New Violation. Correct By: 05/31/2026

The ice scoop is stored with the handle in-contact with the food (ice). During pauses in food preparation, utensils must be stored on a clean surface or in a clean, protected location. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/11/2024
The facility is lacking thermo labels or similar internal temperature indicating device for the dish machine at the coffe-bar. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/11/2024
